lines.trans: How could you betray our agency?
It is only business, Andréa.
You stole all my actors!
Why make this situation so personal?
I spent nights staying awake.
You are far too emotional, my dear.
I lost my own family for them.
It is very touching, but it is over.
I am proud of my accomplished work.
You are going to feel very lonely from now on.
You have no respect for the artists.
They all prefer to sign with me.
Repeat that to my face if you dare!
Let go of my arm immediately, stop!

examples.text: Il a accompli un grand travail.
Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il arrête de travailler à six heures.

meanings.note: un grand artiste = a great artist
aucune before a feminine noun; usually with ne

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
le bras droit = the right arm
être le bras droit de quelqu'un = to be someone's right hand

examples.trans: I will become his right hand.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: J'ai perdu un ami très cher.
examples.trans: I've lost a very dear friend.

meanings.note: before the noun: un ami très cher
after the noun or after être
comment ça va? = how are you?

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus

examples.text: Je suis là pour eux tous les jours.
examples.trans: I'm here for them every day.

meanings.en: them (stressed pronoun, masculine or mixed plural)
meanings.note: after a preposition: pour eux, avec eux

meanings.en: face, front; face à = facing, in the face of, confronted with

examples.trans: To look straight in the face.

examples.text: C'est pour faire plaisir à ma famille.
examples.trans: It's to make my family happy.

examples.text: Il est fier de son travail.

examples.trans: I've really grown to love this tax audit!

meanings.en: to end up doing (finir par + infinitive)

meanings.note: for a group of men, or a mixed group; elles for women only

examples.text: Je dois régler ce problème immédiatement.
examples.trans: I must settle this problem immediately.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

meanings.en: to let go of, to drop

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: to dare, have the courage to do something

examples.trans: I don't dare ask him the question.

meanings.note: vous ne perdez pas grand-chose = you're not missing much

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more
son propre salon = her own salon
une chambre propre = a clean room
je préfère = I prefer; tu préférerais = would you rather

rendre.gloss: to give back, to return; to make (someone happy/sad)

meanings.note: rendre service = to do a favour

examples.text: J'ai beaucoup de respect pour elle.
examples.trans: I have a lot of respect for her.

meanings.en: to rehearse, to practise (a role, a play)

je sens quelque chose de compliqué

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

veiller.gloss: to watch over, to look after

meanings.en: to watch over, to look after, to ensure

meanings.note: place: à Paris, à mon cours
